merchant/30879.htm.text: Wharf Manager Felton: From here many ships come and go to other ports on the continent, including Talking Island. Without this port, Giran's giant market would not exist! It may look just like a sleepy little port to you, but mark my words: soon a village will be built near here. I hear that the Dw…

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

Q00035_FindGlitteringJewelry/30879-01.ht.text: Wharf Manager Felton: What brings you here? The boat with the ore Ellie's looking for still hasn't arrived. If you're in a hurry, why don't you go get some yourself?

Q00035_FindGlitteringJewelry/30879-03.ht.text: Wharf Manager Felton: You can get it from alligators on Alligator Beach . Ellie wanted 10 ores . They are ferocious, so be careful!

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/30879-01.htm.text: Wharf Manager Felton: Why did you come to me? The cargo has been delayed by a storm. If that's what you're here for, you'll have to wait a little longer. We're not delaying things on purpose, I promise you. You're looking for someone? There are many people moving about this wharf... I'm afraid you'…

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/30879-04.htm.text: Wharf Manager Felton: Is there anything else you want to ask? I think I told you about the location of the shipwreck, so go check it out.

Q00035_FindGlitteringJewelry/30879-02.ht.text: Wharf Manager Felton: If you don't want to wait, you can get the ore by hunting the Alligators on Alligator Beach . Ellie's order was for 10 ore . They are ferocious, so be careful!

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/30879-02.htm.text: Wharf Manager Felton: Hmm.. Now that you mention it, I think I did see that person before. Yes! He asked me about the direction of the cargo ship. Then he disappeared after I told him that we were salvaging the goods from the cargo ship that had been shipwrecked near the entrance to Devil's Isle.

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/30879-03.htm.text: Wharf Manager Felton: Since they were shipwrecked near the entrance, it should be near the broken bridge on your way to Devil's Isle. Go see for yourself.
